answer: One pearl is one forged identity. The garden is the register of identities; the vault is the escrow each one lodges stake in, forfeit if it cheats. A newcomer lodges a stake equal to the number of rows already in the garden, so honest early rows paid base while the k-th clone locks k times base: a fleet of a thousand locks half a million base stakes at once, since the count includes their own clones and locked stake cannot be split or withdrawn. It breaks if a batch of newcomers can enter at one price.
